title: uas-sort first-card expected folder list
description: The folders the user expects uas-sort-cli plan to propose for the first real card (Ref §4.5, §13). Compared by uas-sort-cli plan --expect; acceptance passes at 2 edits or fewer.

relPath.description: Folder path relative to the video root, e.g. 2026\2026-10\2026-10-04 Nome Roads (an existing folder for an append).

clips.description: Bare file names of the card's MP4 clips that belong in this folder.

target.description: Optional: the target kind you expect. When given, a different kind counts as one edit (a Retarget).
